objective: Define the canonical pre-authoritative storycraft vocabulary, creative-fragment object model, lifecycle, authority, Personal/Campaign binding, stable identity/version/provenance, deletion/reference integrity, and explicit incorporation/conversion boundaries into owning domains so creative possibilities cannot masquerade as authoritative truth.
design_findings: Creative Fragments are fixed pre-authoritative objects and never become target-domain truth by lifecycle or linking alone.
Normalized fragment vocabulary excludes authoritative object kinds and deliberately avoids duplicating A9 runtime hypothesis identity.
Lifecycle is inbox, scratch, developing, ready, incorporated, superseded, archived, tombstoned; ready/incorporated do not imply approval or truth.
Personal and Campaign-bound creative contexts are separate and Campaign binding remains preparation rather than runtime truth.
Ownership, authorship, view, edit, link, branch, share, bind, incorporate, archive, tombstone, restore and export are independent authorities.
Incorporation always pins a source fragment version and delegates target creation/change to the owning domain; source and target never silently synchronize.
A10 D18/D28/D29/D05 split remains controlling and CSW-01 authorizes no new persistence root.
A9 runtime hypotheses remain objectiveTruth=false until their own authorized conclusion path; creative relationships do not become runtime evidence by analogy.
Tombstones preserve reference/provenance integrity while remaining visibility-filtered.
Optional AI and APM automation remain nonauthoritative and cannot publish, incorporate or promote by themselves.
preserved_parallel_tracks: APM-02 waits on later APW dependencies
nonauthorization: training on private user creative material
